title: Pan-Seared Samphire with Indian Naan
description: A unique Italian-inspired dish featuring pan-seared samphire and crispy indian naan. This recipe is perfect for a quick dinner.
instructions: Cut the naan into bite-sized pieces and bake in the preheated oven for 5-7 minutes, or until crispy.
Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the samphire to the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes, or until tender.
Add the plump to the skillet and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until heated through.
Stir in the garlic, lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Serve the samphire and plump over the crispy naan pieces.
